BranchID.description: Optional branch scope; authorization still verifies organization membership and branch access.
BranchID.name: X-Branch-ID

CorrelationID.description: Optional trace correlation identifier; echoed in responses.
CorrelationID.name: X-Correlation-ID

IdempotencyKey.description: Required replay key. Reuse with the same fingerprint returns the stable result; reuse with a different fingerprint returns 409.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

IfMatch.description: Expected aggregate version. The equivalent expectedVersion JSON field may be used; one of them is required.
IfMatch.name: If-Match

QuotationTokenQuery.description: Secure quotation token for emailed links. Authorization bearer transport is preferred because URLs may be logged.
QuotationTokenQuery.name: token

RequestID.description: Optional request identifier accepted by shared HTTP middleware.
RequestID.name: X-Request-ID

ServiceName.description: Verified service identity, also checked against the SLA caller allowlist.
ServiceName.name: X-Service-Name

ServiceNonce.description: Single-use nonce bound into the HMAC.
ServiceNonce.name: X-Service-Nonce

ServiceSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over version, caller, method, request target, timestamp, nonce, and body hash.
ServiceSignature.name: X-Service-Signature

ServiceTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp bound into the HMAC and checked for freshness.
ServiceTimestamp.name: X-Service-Timestamp

Sort.description: Supported deterministic sort expression; unsupported values are rejected.
Sort.name: sort

Error404.description: Safe not found or disabled feature.

Error409.description: Idempotency, version, uniqueness, or state conflict.

Error410.description: Quotation token expired or no longer valid.

customerAccessToken.description: Returned exactly once; never persisted raw.
Optional raw secure token returned exactly once when mintCustomerToken is true.

CorporateBearer.description: Bearer access token followed by organization membership resolution and organization, branch, and permission enforcement.

QuotationToken.description: Hashed, expiring, rate-limited token bound to exactly one quotation and version. The raw token is never persisted. Emailed links may alternatively supply the token query parameter.

ServiceHMACv2.description: Shared HMAC signature v2 with verified caller identity, method, request-target, timestamp, nonce, and body-hash binding; caller allowlist, freshness, and single-use nonce are enforced.
ServiceHMACv2.name: X-Service-Signature

info.description: This specification covers Section 14 only. Section 13 is documented separately and Section 15 is deferred. Quotation acceptance creates a conversion intent, not an order. CRM customers are separate from marketplace customer identities. Fleet does not own accounts receivable and does not calculate marketplace fares, commissions, debt, or available credit.
info.title: KarryGo Fleet Partner — Section 14 CRM API
